reading.title: PILOT Agreement Approval - New Carrollton - Affordable - Phase 3 - 9%

signatures.party: Prince George's County Government Office of the County Executive

candidates.quote: The Owner, Urban Atlantic Development LLC, will form an entity for the purpose of acquiring land and constructing a fifty (50) unit affordable rental community for low and moderate-income families, earning fifty percent (50%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located within the confines of Pennsy Drive, Route 50 and Corporate Drive, New Carrollton, Maryland 20785.

The Owner, Urban Atlantic Development LLC, will form an entity for the purpose of acquiring land and constructing a fifty (50) unit affordable rental community for low and moderate-income families, earning fifty percent (50%) or below of the Area Median Income (“AMI”), located within the confines of Pennsy Drive, Route 50 and Corporate Drive, New Carrollton, Maryland 20785.
candidates.wording: earning fifty percent (50%) or below of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment in an amount no less than approximately two thousand, five hundred dollars or fifty dollars per unit ($2,500 or $50 per unit) for the first year.
candidates.wording: PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment
candidates.value: $2,500 or $50 per unit for the first year

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for forty (40) years, which includes the extended affordability period.
candidates.wording: remain in effect for forty (40) years
